title: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A small frogfolk of Pondside who has visions and draws them, feels useless, and flees a Calamity Beast's attack.

entities.name: Nerys
entities.description: A stern rabbitfolk of Pondside who scolds Helga for wasting time.

entities.name: Euan
entities.description: A villager who told Helga not to return after a ruined batch of medicine.

entities.name: Iver
entities.description: The frogfolk augur of Pondside who dismisses Helga's visions.

entities.name: Annik
entities.description: A neighbor of Iver who sweeps her porch.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: The ruler in Fountainport whose library holds a tome on Calamity Beasts and with whom Helga trained.

entities.name: Maha, the Night Owl
entities.description: A Calamity Beast, an enormous owl with turquoise magic that brings night in its wake and destroys Pondside.

entities.name: Sun Hawk
entities.description: A Calamity Beast illustrated in King Glarb's tome, which Helga's drawing resembles.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Fearsome heralds of nature's changes, seasonal and chaotic.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A mousefolk of Goodhill, a mother and rapier-wielding guardian's daughter, on her birthday.

entities.name: Clem
entities.description: Mabel's husband, a baker of cookies and a loving father.

entities.name: Rosalyn
entities.description: Mabel and Clem's eldest child.

entities.name: Foggy
entities.description: One of Mabel's children.

entities.name: Pip
entities.description: Mabel's youngest child.

entities.name: Oliver
entities.description: The nosy rabbitfolk mayor of Goodhill who asks Mabel to display her family relic.

entities.name: Jenefer
entities.description: A weaselfolk who tells Oliver about the stranger in Pond Creek.

entities.name: Lowenna
entities.description: A lookout who found the stranger.

entities.name: Delen
entities.description: Goodhill's healer.

entities.name: Iris
entities.description: Mabel's mother, the guardian of the family artifact.

entities.name: Elis
entities.description: Mabel's father.

entities.name: Silver
entities.description: A bard who plans to tell the Order of the Holly Leaf tale.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker hunting Jace, who is transformed into a furred animalfolk in Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: Ral's husband and a brilliant, loving partner.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The planeswalker Ral believes is alive and is hunting after learning he masqueraded as Ashiok to steal a creature.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A white-haired planeswalker who lost her spark, living in a palace garden, who tells Ral how to trace aether trails.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: A small frogfolk village hit by the Night Owl.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: A town of mousefolk and rabbitfolk where Mabel lives.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: The city where Helga began magical training under King Glarb.

entities.name: Pond Creek
entities.description: The stream where Helga collapses.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The land of Bloomburrow where Pondside and Goodhill lie.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The ruined Thunder Junction town where Ral last saw Jace.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A plane of animalfolk to which Ral is transported.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The Wild West plane where Ral last saw Jace.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Ral's home city-plane.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: An order whose story Silver tells, tied to Mabel's ancestry.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which Ral follows Jace's aether trail.

events.summary: Nerys scolds Helga for neglecting her chores and fishing for visions at the pond.
events.quote: And get your head out of yon scrying pool,

events.summary: Helga sees that her drawing resembles a Calamity Beast and resolves to show it to Iver.
events.quote: If she were having a true seeing of a Calamity Beast, her village could be in grave danger.

events.summary: Maha, the Night Owl, appears over Pondside as the village bell clangs.
The Night Owl swoops over Pondside, destroying houses and starting fires while villagers flee.
Helga tumbles into Pond Creek, finds the sky in darkness, and chooses to go for help rather than hide.
events.quote: limped along the creek-bed toward the far-off promise of sunshine.

events.summary: Mabel, on her birthday in Goodhill, is pressed by Mayor Oliver to bring out her family relic.
events.quote: Perhaps this would be an appropriate occasion to bring out that old relic you have tucked away in your attic

events.summary: Mabel saves her tumbling children, and Clem returns to the household.
events.quote: With one paw, she slung Pip onto her shoulder

events.summary: Jenefer reports a stranger in Pond Creek, and Mabel grabs her rapier.
events.quote: "There's a stranger in Pond Creek, and she don't look well at all."

events.summary: The collapsed Helga tells Mabel she was attacked by a Calamity Beast, and Mabel takes her home.
Mabel decides to shelter Helga and postpone her birthday party.
events.quote: my birthday party will have to wait.

events.summary: Ral, back on Ravnica, vows to kill Jace for hiding as Ashiok and stealing a creature, and tells Tomik his plan to seek help.
events.quote: Beleren is alive, and I'm going to kill him.

events.summary: The Wanderer tells Ral she cannot help as her spark is gone, but advises him to open his soul at the last place he saw Jace.
events.quote: "I can no longer walk the planes. My spark is gone."

events.summary: Ral returns to the ruins of Tarnation and finds a faint trace of Jace's aether trail.
events.quote: Ral focused on that trace with every part of himself.

events.summary: Ral follows the trail into the Blind Eternities and arrives in a field in Bloomburrow, transformed into an animal.
events.quote: "I'm going to kill him!" Ral shouted

relations.quote: "She's always been my hero," Clem said loyally.
Rosalyn, the eldest and largest, formed the base

relations.note: Iris is Mabel's mother and guardian of the artifact.

relations.quote: Ral pressed a kiss to his husband's mouth to silence him.

relations.note: Ral is furious with Jace and swears to kill him, though Tomik says he is a friend.
The Calamity Beast attacks and destroys Pondside.
relations.quote: demolishing the mousefolk house with its half-finished roof
Oliver, the mayor, trundled straight toward her.

relations.note: Helga began magical training in Fountainport with King Glarb but did not complete it.
relations.quote: completed her training with King Glarb
